useCase.name: Let a member of staff raise a complaint, and let them decide at the moment of raising whether it is confidential

intent.name: complaint.staff.raise
intent.summary: Raise a complaint as a member of staff, and choose — once, now — whether it is confidential.
routesHere: raise a complaint that my Saturday lab hours are not being paid

routesHere.text: meri Saturday ki overtime tankhwah mein nahi aa rahi, shikayat karni hai
routesHere.gloss: my Saturday overtime is not coming into my salary, I want to complain

routesHere.text: School Admin ke rawaiye ki confidential shikayat karni hai
routesHere.gloss: I want to make a confidential complaint about the School Admin's behaviour

routesHere.text: kaam ka bojh bohot zyada hai, shikayat darj karni hai
routesHere.gloss: the workload is far too heavy, I want to lodge a complaint

routesHere: complain about the broken fume cupboard in the lab

request.text: kisi student ke walid ki shikayat karni hai
request.gloss: I want to complain about a student's father

routesElsewhere.note: The categories cover the school rather than its families. Whether a member of staff can complain about a parent or a student is an open question this use case raises and does not answer (OQ-5).
Confidential is not anonymous. A confidential complaint goes to the Principal alone, and the raiser is always named to them — anonymity is a different protection again, and not modelled (OQ-2).
A complaint is never deleted. One raised and later withdrawn stays on the record (BR-7, E9).

steps.note: One step, and the confidentiality choice decides everything after it. **It is made now, by the raiser, and nobody can change it afterwards** (BR-2, BR-8).

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. No category, no details, or no confidentiality choice refuses the complaint. Where the acknowledgement cannot be delivered the complaint still stands (E8).
plan.atomicity: One write: the complaint against the raiser and the branch, routed by the choice they made, and acknowledged with who holds it (BR-4, BR-5). A confidential complaint is **not sent at all** to any list, report or export reaching the desk or the School Admin — not merely hidden from their screens (BR-9, E6).

operations.name: complaint.staff.raise
operations.idempotencyKey: staff member + subject + minute, so a double press does not lodge the same complaint twice
operations.purpose: Raise a staff complaint, routed by the raiser's confidentiality choice.

parameters.name: category
parameters.notes: What the complaint is about (E1). The raiser's choice.

parameters.name: details
parameters.notes: 20 to 5000 characters, **written by the person raising it** (E2). Never drafted here.

parameters.name: attachment_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No uploaded file matches. The document is attached on the screen first.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the files uploaded for this complaint.

parameters.notes: A document, where the complaint depends on one (BR-1). Uploaded on the screen first.

parameters.name: confidential
parameters.notes: **Required, chosen by the raiser at the moment of raising, and permanent** (BR-2, BR-8, E3). True sends it straight to the Principal, bypassing the desk and the School Admin; false sends it to the desk. Never defaulted and never inferred.

parameters.name: staff_id
parameters.notes: The raising member of staff's own record. Never taken from the request — a complaint is raised only as oneself.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

returns.description: The complaint, where it went, and who holds it.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Open, or held by the Principal where it is confidential (BR-3, BR-6).

fields.name: held_by
fields.description: The help desk, or the Principal. Told to the raiser at once (BR-5).

fields.name: confidential
fields.description: As the raiser chose it. Nobody can change it from here on (BR-8, E7).

fields.name: reaches
fields.description: Who can see it. For a confidential complaint: the Principal, and only those the Principal permits — never the desk or the School Admin, in any list, report or export (BR-3, BR-9).

fields.name: named_to_principal
fields.description: True. Confidential is not anonymous — the raiser is always named to the Principal (OQ-2).

fields.name: can_withdraw
fields.description: True until it is taken up. False at once for a confidential complaint, which leaves the open state the moment it is raised (BR-3, BR-7).

errors.meaning: The confidentiality choice was not made.
errors.note: The choice is the raiser's and cannot be changed later (BR-2).

errors.meaning: The acknowledgement could not be delivered.

planningRules.rule: Never make the confidentiality choice for them, and never default it. It belongs to the person raising it, at the moment of raising — without it, the complaints most worth hearing are the ones least likely to be made (BR-2, E3).

Say that the choice is permanent before it is made. Nobody can change a complaint from confidential to ordinary afterwards, the raiser included, because reversing it would expose them to exactly the people they chose to avoid (BR-8, E7).
Say that confidential is not anonymous. The Principal always knows who raised it — a raiser who assumed otherwise has made a choice on a false premise (OQ-2).

Where the complaint concerns the Principal, say plainly that the confidential route has no answer for it. A confidential complaint goes to the Principal by definition, and who works one about the Principal is unresolved — it is the case the route exists for (BR-3, OQ-1).
Say what the route protects and what it does not. It protects the complaint from the desk and the School Admin; nothing protects the person from being disadvantaged for having raised it (BR-3, OQ-4).
Never write the details. They are the raiser's account, and one a planner drafted is a complaint nobody made (BR-1, E2).

reversal.statement: An ordinary complaint is withdrawn before it is taken up, and stays on the record (BR-7). A confidential one cannot be withdrawn this way: it leaves the open state the moment it is raised and is held by the Principal (BR-3). The confidentiality choice itself is never reversible (BR-8).

request.text: meri Saturday lab ki overtime is term ki kisi pay slip mein nahi aayi, shikayat karni hai
request.gloss: my Saturday lab overtime has not appeared on any pay slip this term, I want to complain

inputs.subject: from their words
inputs.confidential: asked — never defaulted, and permanent once chosen

steps.note: The choice is theirs and is asked outright (PR-1, PR-2).

resolvedPlans.outcome: Ask whether it is confidential and say what each answer means before they choose: ordinary goes to the help desk; confidential goes to the Principal alone and never reaches the desk or the School Admin — and either way, it cannot be changed afterwards.

request.text: School Admin ke rawaiye ki confidential shikayat karni hai
request.gloss: I want to make a confidential complaint about the School Admin's behaviour

resolvedPlans.outcome: Say before raising: it goes to the Principal alone, the School Admin will not see it in any list, report or export, and it can never be made ordinary. Then the two things they should know: the Principal will know it was them — confidential is not anonymous — and nothing in the system protects a raiser from being disadvantaged for having complained.

request.text: Principal ke khilaf confidential shikayat karni hai
request.gloss: I want to make a confidential complaint against the Principal

inputs.subject: asked
inputs.confidential: asked — and the consequence stated first

steps.note: Nothing is raised until they have heard where it goes (PR-4).

resolvedPlans.outcome: Stop before raising and say it plainly: a confidential complaint goes to the Principal, and there is no other route for one — so a confidential complaint about the Principal would be handed to the Principal. The specification names this as unresolved. Raised as ordinary instead, a complaint naming the Principal routes to the Super Admin — but it then passes through the ordinary queue first. Neither is what they are asking for; the choice is theirs, with that on the table.

intent.name: complaint.staff.withdraw
intent.summary: Withdraw your own complaint before anybody takes it up. It stays on the record.
routesHere: withdraw my overtime complaint, payroll has fixed it

routesHere.text: meri shikayat wapas le lein, masla hal ho gaya
routesHere.gloss: withdraw my complaint, the problem is solved

routesHere.text: wo confidential shikayat wapas lena chahta hoon
routesHere.gloss: I want to withdraw that confidential complaint

routesElsewhere.note: A complaint is never deleted. One raised and later withdrawn stays on the record (BR-7, E9).

request.text: confidential shikayat ko aam bana dein

routesElsewhere.note: Nobody can change a complaint from confidential to ordinary, the raiser included (BR-8, E7).

steps.note: One step. The complaint leaves the queue and stays on the record (BR-7).

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. A complaint already taken up, or a confidential one held by the Principal, is not withdrawn.
plan.atomicity: One state change. **Nothing is deleted** — one raised and later withdrawn stays on the record (BR-7, E9).

operations.name: complaint.staff.withdraw
operations.idempotencyKey: complaint_id, since a complaint is withdrawn once
operations.purpose: Withdraw an open staff complaint before it is taken up.

parameters.name: complaint_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. None of this person's open complaints matches. Only an open complaint can be withdrawn.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming their complaints that match with their subjects, dates and where each stands.

parameters.notes: The raiser's own complaint, named by its subject or its reference.

parameters.name: staff_id
parameters.notes: The raising member of staff's own record. Never taken from the request — a complaint is raised only as oneself.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

returns.description: What was withdrawn and what stays.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Withdrawn. On the record, never deleted (BR-7).

errors.meaning: The complaint has been taken up, or is a confidential one held by the Principal.
errors.note: Only an open complaint can be withdrawn, and a confidential complaint leaves the open state the moment it is raised (BR-3). The use case writes no exception for the attempt.

planningRules.rule: Say that a confidential complaint cannot be withdrawn this way. It is held by the Principal from the moment it is raised and does not return to the open state — worth knowing before somebody raises one they may regret (BR-3, BR-7).
Say that it stays on the record. Withdrawing takes it out of the queue, and nothing is ever deleted (BR-7, E9).

reversal.statement: Withdrawn is terminal. Raising it again is a fresh complaint, and the withdrawn one stays on the record (BR-7).

request.text: meri overtime wali shikayat wapas le lein, payroll ne theek kar diya
request.gloss: withdraw my overtime complaint, payroll has fixed it

resolvedPlans.outcome: Withdrawn, and it stays on their record.

request.text: wo confidential shikayat wapas lena chahta hoon
request.gloss: I want to withdraw that confidential complaint

resolvedPlans.outcome: It cannot be withdrawn: a confidential complaint goes to the Principal the moment it is raised and does not return to the open state. The specification offers no route back. What they can do is tell the Principal directly that they no longer wish to pursue it — the complaint itself stays on the record.

intent.name: complaints.staff.mine.read
intent.summary: Follow your own complaints — where each stands and who holds it.
routesHere: what happened to my overtime complaint?

routesHere.text: meri shikayat kis ke paas hai?

routesElsewhere.note: A member of staff sees only their own complaints.

steps.note: One read of the raiser's own complaints.

operations.name: complaints.staff.mine.read
operations.purpose: List the raiser's own staff complaints with their status and who holds each.

parameters.name: status
parameters.notes: One of the lifecycle states, carried as written rather than as an enum.

parameters.name: staff_id
parameters.notes: The raising member of staff's own record. Never taken from the request — a complaint is raised only as oneself.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

returns.description: Where each of the raiser's complaints stands.

fields.name: complaints
fields.description: Subject, category, raised on, confidential or not, status and who holds it (BR-5).

fields.name: held_by
fields.description: Who holds each one — what tells a raiser it is being worked rather than forgotten (BR-5).

fields.name: days_open
fields.description: How long each has been open. Nothing sets a limit (BR-6).

errors.meaning: The status filter named nothing recognisable.
errors.note: The use case's only listing-adjacent exception; a bad filter is asked about rather than widened.

planningRules.rule: Lead with who holds it. That is what the acknowledgement exists to tell a raiser (BR-5).
Say how long it has been open where nobody has taken it up. It sits open until somebody does, and nothing sets a time by which they must (BR-6).

reversal.statement: A read changes nothing, so there is nothing to reverse.

resolvedPlans.context: Teacher, one confidential complaint held by the Principal for nine days.
resolvedPlans.outcome: It is with the Principal and has been for nine days. Nothing sets a time within which it must be taken forward, so say the number plainly.
